submission.comment: Best strategy found: MA crossover with fast=6, slow=18, vol_target=true, long_only=false achieves 0.78 annualized Sharpe. No strategy reached Sharpe > 1.0 on this dataset. The highest raw Sharpe was 0.826 for mean_reversion (lookback=10, entry_z=2.5) but with negligible trading (0.7% time in market, 3% annual return). The MA crossover family consistently performed best among strategies with meaningful market exposure.
